
Lojban-internal name for [[cmavo|cmavo]] of [[selma'o|selma'o]] BAI, and also [[PU|PU]], [[ZAhO|ZAhO]], etc. Anything that can tag a [[sumti|sumti]].

The full list is:

# [[fi'o|fi'o]] + [[selbri|selbri]]

# [[BAI|BAI]]

# [[CAhA|CAhA]]

# [[KI|KI]]

# [[CUhE|CUhE]] (i.e. [[cu'e|cu'e]] and [[nau|nau]])

# [[ZI|ZI]]

# [[ZEhA|ZEhA]]

# [[PU|PU]]

# [[VA|VA]]

# [[FAhA|FAhA]] and [[MOhI|MOhI]] + [[FAhA|FAhA]]

# [[VEhA|VEhA]]

# [[VIhA|VIhA]]

# [[PA|PA]] + [[ROI|ROI]]

# [[TAhE|TAhE]] (plus [[fe'e|fe'e]])

# [[ZAhO|ZAhO]] (plus [[fe'e|fe'e]])

Plus combinations of them.

[[tanru versus lujvo rant|tanru versus lujvo rant]] argues that ''sumtcita'' is a better term.
